unavailableAttributes.description: Exact attributes freshly found unavailable by a successful correlated native-group report-attributes read. Presence, including an empty list, is unsupported for endpoint, capability-query, proactive or uncorrelated reports. These identities carry no value or sample time; omission is not an unavailable acknowledgement. Upgrade consuming hosts before providers emit this field.
